name: Git Lens: Inline Blame & Diff
author: Tahr Team
description: Git intelligence with Inline Blame on the active line, gutter diff indicators, and interactive side-by-side diff view

inline_blame.description: Show author and commit age at the end of the active cursor line

blame_delay_ms.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before fetching inline blame
